payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP array dp[i] representing max score ending at problem i; nested loop over all j < i with different tags updates both dp[i] and dp[j] using absolute score differences, exploiting the exponential complexity property.
payload.rationale: The DP state is a single dimension (problem index). Transitions consider pairs (i, j) symmetrically, but state remains 1D. The nested loop is O(n^2) but does not constitute a second state dimension; rather it's a transition over all previous states.
